title: Genesys VTT
description: Genesys VTT 0.0.159 QA: removes legacy QA/test surfaces from the normal Character Sheet without removing the underlying rules engine. The injected Talents & Rule Elements regression panel is hidden from Equipment, Effects and Configure are removed from primary navigation while remaining reachable through the Biography status bar and header Configure action, and explicit Advanced/QA blocks are removed from normal use. Preserves Biography status bar, XP/Funds header, two-row Characteristics and Health & Defense snapshot, five-pip Skills, Talent Tier lanes, Rule Engine, Extra Activation UX, and Narrative Results Assistant.
